citations.narrative:
During the inspection, the APHIS Official observed bears, spotted hyenas, and striped hyenas on the premises. When
asked whether these animals were being exhibited, the facility representative confirmed that they were included as part of
the public tour. Records reviewed during the inspection confirmed that the facility acquired one Kodiak bear on
10/14/2025, three striped hyenas on 6/05/2026, and two spotted hyenas on 3/09/2026. However, the facility's current
license does not authorize the exhibition of bears or hyenas.
Licenses must specifically authorize the use of each of the following groups of animals: Group 5 (baboons and
nonbrachiating species larger than 33 lbs.) and Group 6 (great apes over 55 lbs. and brachiating species) nonhuman
primates; exotic and wild felids (including but not limited to lions, tigers, leopards, cheetahs, jaguars, cougars, lynx,
servals, bobcats, and caracals, and any hybrid cross thereof); hyenas and/or exotic and wild canids (including but not
limited to wolves, coyotes, foxes, and jackals); bears; and mega-herbivores (including but not limited to elephants,
rhinoceroses, hippopotamuses, and giraffes). The licensee must obtain a new license authorizing these animal groups
before exhibiting any animal that is beyond the types or numbers authorized under the existing license.
Corrected by the end of inspection.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with Facility Representative.
